week_report.title: Krabville Week One
week_report.headline: Two moons, one shared dream, and a brass key
week_report.narrative: Krabville's first week mixed ordinary Lagoon life with impossible skies. Residents worked, ate, talked, weathered a storm, watched two reflected moons, shared one lighthouse dream, and ended the week puzzling over a dry brass key.
